entities.name: The Wealth of Nations (Adam Smith)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Published in 1776, Adam Smith's "An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations" is the founding text of modern economics. Its concepts — the invisible hand, division of labor, free trade, and self-interest as an engine of public good — dismantled mercantilism and provided the intellectual foundation for capitalism. Published the same year as the American Declaration of Independence.
